_note: Shape recorded from a real Liara account by a read-only live spike on 2026-10-23 (GET /v1/projects/{name}/events?teamID=<team id>). KEY NAMES, JSON TYPES and the shape (data[] newest first, `time` = unix seconds as a STRING, Docker-style action/status, release id + tag) are as recorded; container ids, release id, tag and timestamps are SYNTHETIC. Observed live: create/start/kill/die/stop/destroy; presumed, not yet observed: oom/restart. `data` holds the create/start pair as recorded; `syntheticStopSequence` is a SYNTHETIC example (made-up ids and times, newest first) of the other observed actions kill/die/stop/destroy, kept so the parser is exercised on every observed action.
